Closed set asserted by Go tests: TestPromSchedulerClosedVocabulary and TestPromSchedulerHealthFamilies (internal/metrics/prom_scheduler_test.go:70-160, 216-260) assert series count == len(TickOutcomes)/len(SkipReasons) and that out-of-vocabulary values are dropped — both PASS. Live 8766 unit untouched: systemctl show off-by-one -> ActiveEnterTimestamp=Wed 2026-11-04 17:28:53 -05, MainPID=1871714, NRestarts=0, /health 200 before and after, and its /metrics/prom contains 0 of the new families (old binary still serving). Full gate: go build ./... exit 0, go vet ./... exit 0, gofmt -l cmd/ internal/ pkg/ sql/ empty, go test ./... -short -count=1 -p 1 -timeout 300s -> all 16 packages ok (internal/metrics ok 0.030s, internal/cron ok 0.132s, internal/api ok 0.903s).
